component.name: Airlock
component.summary: Browse privately with ads and trackers blocked

description.p: Airlock is a privacy browser. It blocks ads and trackers, keeps every page on a secure connection, and lets you erase everything with one button.

ul.li: Ad and tracker blocking with EasyList, EasyPrivacy and Airlock's own tracker list
Cookie banners hidden, tracking removed from links
HTTPS only: plain connections are upgraded, and Airlock asks before loading one that can't be
Private tabs that share nothing with each other or with your normal tabs
Burn: close every tab and erase cookies, cache and site data in one step
Websites can't reach devices on your local network
Private search engines to choose from, with the ones that aren't private clearly marked
Feeds: follow a site's RSS or Atom feed, or a page with no feed at all

description.p: First Linux release: tabs and private tabs, ad and tracker blocking, HTTPS only, Burn, and Feeds.
